name: Computational Multibody Dynamics
description:
Kinematics, Angular velocity, Composition of angular velocity, Euler Newton formulation of
equations of motion, energy based formulation of equations of motion (Hamilton’s principle and Lagrange’s equations of motion), constraints equations (2D & 3D) and Actuators, system level multibody equation formulation for 2D examples, numerical integration of the E.O.M of the system (2D), orientation parameterization: Euler angles, Euler parameters, Quaternions, examples of 3D rigid multibody systems, flexible-multibody systems (governing equations).
